title: Librarian
description: Acquires a source and files it. `person` rather than `agent`, and the distinction is load-bearing: the decisions this actor owns are the ones an unattended engine must NOT make on its own — whether a capture may be redistributed, whether a logged-in view counts as the public document, and when an approximate vocabulary term is worse than a local one. An agent performs the capture; a person settles what it means.
